formulas.formula: Pretty, simple and actually useful. Your money, your goals, your way.
1. Setup: your name and the year.
2. Income: every paycheck and side-hustle payment.
3. Bill Checklist: your bills, then tick each one off every month. So satisfying.
4. Budget: plan each category for one month. Spent fills in from Expenses.
5. Expenses: log what you spend. Pick a category from the list.
6. Savings Goals and Wish List: dream it, plan it, save for it.
7. Dashboard and Monthly: your month and year at a glance.
Move money to savings on payday, before the shopping cart does.
Budget for coffee, nails and fun. A budget you love is a budget you keep.
Wait 30 days before buying a Want. If you still love it, it's yours.
Pick one day a month to check off bills. Five minutes, total peace of mind.
Clear the white cells on Income, Bill Checklist, Budget, Expenses, Savings Goals and Wish List.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid, reached, or money left.
Yellow: due soon, or almost there.
Red: late, over budget, or something to check.
Set this up once. Everything else uses it.
Your monthly bills. Tick the box when each one is paid. This month is highlighted.
Plan one month. Spent comes from Expenses for the current month.

=IF(R4<=0,"Add your income to compare.","Average income: "&TEXT(R4,"$#,##0")&" a month. "&IF(C26>R4,"Your plan is "&TEXT(C26-R4,"$#,##0")&" over. Trim a little.","Your plan fits with "&TEXT(R4-C26,"$#,##0")&" to spare."))
What you spend. Moving money to savings? Use the Savings category.
Your year month by month. Saved = money moved to the Savings category.
What you're saving for. Per Month = what to set aside each month to hit the date.
Things you'd love. Save for them first, then tick Bought. Ready = you've saved enough.
